title: Expanded notation: writing a number as a sum of its place values

blocks.content: Expanded notation breaks a number open so you can see the value of every digit. It is a clear way to show what a number is really made of.
Expanded notation writes a number as the sum of each digit's value: 345 = 300 + 40 + 5.

steps: The 5 is 500, the 2 is 20, the 6 is 6.

blocks.explain: The 2 is in the tens place, so its value is 20.
blocks.rule: In expanded notation, each part is a digit multiplied by its place value.

practiceItems.prompt: the tens part of 526 in expanded form

blocks.content: To go back to the standard number, just add the place values together.

blocks.rule: Add the place values back together to get the standard number.

blocks.content: Expanded notation shows a number's hidden parts, and adding those parts brings it back together. Let's practise!
